case.summary: An investigation was initiated following an analyst request to examine card losses lacking shared device telemetry. Review of card C01727-K2 revealed three unauthorized online product-C charges totaling $967.68 sent to recipient domain sc.rr.com between January 17 and January 28, 2017, breaking an established baseline of strictly in-person transactions. Legitimate card-present charges continued in region 231 concurrently with the online transactions, demonstrating card-not-present compromise. Graph analysis linked these transactions to an emerging multi-card scheme where 16 other cards directed payments to the same recipient domain over the preceding 30 days. The card has been blocked, connected cards placed on monitoring, and a regulatory report filed.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details an organized card-not-present fraud scheme involving customer C01727 and primary card C01727-K2, connected to an ongoing attack pattern impacting 16 other customer cards. Between January 17, 2017, and January 28, 2017, three unauthorized online transactions totaling $967.68 were executed on card C01727-K2. The unauthorized charges include transaction 3660261 for $305.41 on January 17, 2017, transaction 3660262 for $366.35 on January 18, 2017, and transaction 3660263 for $295.92 on January 28, 2017. All three purchases were conducted online within region 231 for product-C, listing payer email addresses at gmail.com and recipient email addresses at sc.rr.com. No device telemetry, persistent device identifiers, or proxy indicators were captured during the authorization attempts. This activity represents an abrupt departure from the cardholder's baseline of strictly in-person product-W transactions in region 231. Furthermore, legitimate in-person transactions continued locally during this same timeframe, including transactions 3607094 and 3607101, confirming that physical custody of the card was retained while card details were exploited remotely. Knowledge graph analysis identified that 16 other cards, including C05610-K1, C01594-K1, and C03060-K1, similarly transacted with recipient domain sc.rr.com over the prior 30 days, compared to zero in the preceding two months. Card C01727-K2 also has five prior confirmed fraud cases, demonstrating repeat exposure to compromise. The bank has blocked card C01727-K2, initiated monitoring on all 16 connected cards, and filed this report to document the coordinated fraud ring.
